title: tetrapterys rhodopteron

It is used in traditional medicine in various parts of the world due to its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Tetrapterys rhodopteron include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections.
